messages:
Tara Lopez: Quick ask — Greypoint (mid-market healthtech) just requested a hands-on migration clinic next week. Can we open a 60–90m afternoon session that hits EMEA + APAC overlap? They want step-by-step migration guidance and a short live run through.
Mike Huang: Sounds good. How many seats and what's the customer priority list? I can lead the runbook demo if it's more ops-heavy.
Tara Lopez: ~25 attendees (eng + platform owners). Priority: model pinning/version rollouts, routing failovers, and cost/perf tuning (quant/ batching). Also want a dry-run of the migration playbook.
Jana Park: Timezones — proposing 14:00–15:30 UTC to cover late EMEA and early APAC. That should be OK for most. Thoughts? :calendar: 
Sanjay Patel: Heads-up — we're running a Dedicated migration workshop at 14:00 UTC that day. Could we shift to 13:30–15:00 UTC instead? I can be backup host at 13:30.
Jana Park: Running a quick poll — please vote: `poll: ["13:30-15:00 UTC", "14:00-15:30 UTC"]` I'll close in 2h and provision a room + recording.
Remi (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Greypoint Migration Clinic — provisional on CS Collective calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/greypoint-migration-clinic (will update after poll).
Tara Lopez: Roles: Mike to lead migration demo + Q&A, Sanjay backup and runbook walkthrough, Jana handles invites/materials/recording. I'll be in the intro and renewal-risk context. Need a 10-slide agenda + 30m hands-on lab.
Mike Huang: OK — will prep a compact demo: `./playbooks/greypoint-migration.md` (draft). Can we get a test tenant or snapshot of their config? Also prefer to record and share snippets.
Jana Park: Prework checklist I'm posting here: 1) Confirm attendee emails 2) Send short pre-survey (1 min) 3) Provide access instructions and test dataset 4) Link to runbook draft. I'll send invites after poll.
Sanjay Patel: I'll assemble the runbook checklist (rollback steps, KV cache pruning, model-variant fallback policy). Ping me if you need specific customer config access.
Tara Lopez: For feedback capture, use this short form so we can tie answers to renewal signals: https://forms.gle/redwood-cs/greypoint-feedback — questions: "most valuable part?", "riskiest area after clinic?", "willingness to schedule dedicated follow-up?"
Mike Huang: Added to my tasks. I'll post the demo deck by EOD Monday and a short runner script. :thumbsup:
Remi (calendar-bot): Poll closed — majority selected `13:30-15:00 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent to listed attendees. Recording enabled, channel created: #greypoint-migration-clinic.
Tara Lopez: Perfect — thanks everyone. Jana, please share final agenda + slides link when ready and I'll add renewal notes to the meeting doc.
Jana Park: Will do. Shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/greypoint-clinic (slides + runbook + prework). Closing thread for scheduling — follow-ups in #greypoint-migration-clinic.
